events.h: Kurdistan Parliament reactivated with new presidency after two-year deadlock
events.s: The parliament elected Vala Fardi as speaker, Rami Nouri as deputy and Mona Qahwachi as secretary. The KDP and the region's president welcomed the move, while the PUK and New Generation boycotted.
events.t: Functioning Iraqi Kurdish institutions matter to Ankara's relations with Erbil.

events.h: US Democratic Congress may complicate Erdoğan's sanctions relief and fighter jet goals
events.s: Former Turkish diplomats say Democratic control of both chambers could complicate Erdoğan's efforts to win sanctions relief and advanced US fighter jets.
events.t: Congress is the main obstacle to F-35/F-16 access and CAATSA relief.

events.h: Israeli opposition cites US midterms as grounds to remove Netanyahu
events.s: Lapid, Golan and other rivals said Democratic control of Congress shows Netanyahu squandered bipartisan US support. Lapid ruled out a Netanyahu-led unity government, and Golan warned of sanctions and isolation. Right-wing politicians stayed largely silent.

events.h: Democratic win prompts reassessment of US support for Israel
events.s: Analysts say Democratic control of Congress and Republican unease could bring the biggest reassessment of US support for Israel in decades, with more scrutiny of operations in Iran, Gaza and Lebanon. Eleven new lawmakers join advocates pushing to end military support. Israeli commentators say its standing is deteriorating.

events.h: Israeli probe: Shin Bet and IDF knew Deif went underground before October 7
events.s: A Haaretz report on an Israeli investigation says Shin Bet and the IDF knew Hamas military chief Deif had gone underground hours before the attack. Other reports say warnings about Gaza movement were judged routine.

events.h: Israeli strikes and shelling continue in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
events.s: Lebanese state media report Israeli artillery shelling and home burnings in southern Lebanon. A drone strike on a motorcycle in Mercayun hit one person, and another strike killed one.

events.h: Lebanese PM warns Hezbollah off another war; UN warns on peacekeeper withdrawal
events.s: Lebanon's prime minister warned Hezbollah against joining another war. UN peacekeeping chief Lacroix warned that withdrawing peacekeepers from southern Lebanon risks a security vacuum.

events.h: Israeli strikes kill Palestinians in Gaza despite ceasefire
events.s: An Israeli drone hit a tent in Gaza, killing one, and strikes killed three in 24 hours. The IDF and Shin Bet said they killed six militants near Khan Yunis, and Israeli forces bombed displacement camps.

events.h: China confirms talks on possible Xi-Trump-Putin meeting at APEC
events.s: China's foreign ministry said it is in communication with relevant parties on a possible trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen.

events.h: Commission sets no Ukraine accession date as Moldova pulls ahead
events.s: The Commission's report confirms Ukraine meets conditions to open remaining negotiating clusters but sets no membership date. Moldova is seen outpacing Ukraine, and Kyiv aims to start closing chapters in early 2027.

events.h: Ukraine and Western partners meet in Brussels on recovery and 2027 funding
events.s: Delegations from Ukraine, the EU, US, UK, France, Germany, NATO and the World Bank discussed the Prosperity Plan, reconstruction and 2027 funding. They also coordinated ahead of the Abu Dhabi talks. TASS says it ended without practical results.

events.h: Zelensky in Madrid and with Pistorius seeks faster air defence deliveries
events.s: Zelensky arrived in Spain for talks on air defence, defence cooperation and production. He also discussed with Pistorius accelerating PAC-2, IRIS-T and F-16 ammunition deliveries amid a chronic shortage.

events.h: NABU detains senior SBU general; SBU chief dismisses officials
events.s: Anti-corruption detectives detained SBU first deputy head Serhiy Duka and searched other senior SBU officials, with bodyguards allegedly threatening detectives. SBU chief Poklad dismissed two officials implicated in the Carthage probe, and NABU completed its Midas probe on Energoatom.

events.h: Ukrainian intelligence: Russia stockpiled up to 700 ballistic missiles
events.s: Military intelligence estimates Russia held up to 700 ballistic and several thousand cruise missiles as of October. It can produce over 200 missiles per month, including up to 110 ballistic.

events.h: Israeli forces raid villages in Syria's Quneitra countryside
events.s: Israeli forces shelled the Quneitra countryside and moved vehicles and tanks into Jaba al-Khashab, raiding homes and buildings. No casualties were reported.
events.t: Israeli presence in southern Syria complicates Türkiye's Syria strategy.
